content:
The recurrence is \(a_{n+1}=a_n-a_{n-1}\).

Continuing the terms:
\[
2004, 2005, 1, -2004, -2005, -1, 2004, 2005, \dots
\]
So the sequence has period \(6\), and the sum of one full period is
\[
2004+2005+1-2004-2005-1=0.
\]
Since
\[
2005 = 6\cdot 334 + 1,
\]
the sum of the first \(2005\) terms is
\[
0 + 2004 = 2004.
\]

\[
\boxed{2004}
\]
